title: phaseolus vulgaris var. luteus
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. luteus, commonly known as yellow bush bean, is a variety of the common bean plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its nutritional and medicinal properties, providing a rich source of fiber, protein, and various vitamins and minerals. The health benefits of Phaseolus vulgaris var. luteus include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support digestive function, making it a valuable addition to a healthy diet. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which are known for their antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
